title: pedicularis euphrasioides
intro: Pedicularis euphrasioides, commonly known as Chinese foxglove or Euphrasia, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Pedicularis euphrasioides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving coughs, fever reduction, and digestive issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
